title: 第十三章 严家覆灭第十四章 求救
content_zh:
严、罗两家的冲突，在金鼎拍卖结束后，便直接爆发！
据说是严家一支商队，在城外遭遇马贼，拿到确凿证据与罗家有关，当即打上门来。
很粗糙、拙劣的借口，却已没人在意，江宁城各方势力都密切关注着局势进展。
对罗家，并不看好！
胡家驰援已到，严家仍敢动手，可见有极大把握。聪明人并不少，罗振阳通天骨的纷争落幕不久……许多眼神，都看向城北码头。
而近期，清江帮确有异动。
罗家大宅！
严、罗两家众人，已战成一团，杀声震天！
祠堂里的瘸仆，如今腰背挺直，眼中精满四溢，“严硕，你真以为，能动的了罗家？”
严家老祖冷笑，“今日后，江宁再无罗家！”他一步踏落，路面青石碎裂，人如凶兽悍然扑杀。
瘸仆冷笑应上，两位年岁相加近两百的老人，爆发出令人瞠目的恐怖力量。拳脚相碰轰然爆鸣，打的地面崩碎乱石横飞，众人纷纷退避。
万重境的战场，不是他们能插手。
胡冲五十余岁，身躯不高，一双大腿粗壮至极，可知下盘极稳，此时目露凶光，声音似在胸膛擂鼓，“振山，我出手吧！”
罗振山摇头，“徐海还未现身，请胡叔稍等。”
他眉头，忍不住皱起。
如今大战爆发，清江帮既与严家联手，徐海为何还不现身？难道其中另有阴谋！
另一边，严华的脸色，也是阴沉欲滴。
他眼神冰寒，落在身边一人身上，“你们帮主在哪？”
被盯住之人，满头大汗，“这……小人也不知道……”
按计划，徐海出手缠住胡冲，他便可摧枯拉朽，将罗家千山境高手击溃。

到时，大局注定！
岂料关键时刻，徐海竟不现身，这该死的混账莫非要坐山观虎斗？
严华脸色越发难看。
胡冲沉声道：“振山，不能再等了，我下场先重创严家几个高手，即便对方有阴谋，我们也能占据优势。”
罗振山咬牙，“好，胡叔小心！”
“哈哈哈！放心！”胡冲大笑，身影猛地冲出。
嘭——
一拳打出，对面严家千山境高手，面露惊恐。他急忙抵挡，可面对万重强者，身体像是一块大石，被直接轰飞出去。
倒地翻滚几圈，大口吐血，已失去战斗力。
胡冲一个转折，冲向下一个严家高手，他观察战局早已锁定目标，下手又快又狠。
严华低吼，“徐海，竖子也！”
轰——
气息暴涨，瞬间冲破万重境，冲向胡冲。他不能眼睁睁，看胡冲如虎入狼群，重创严家千山境高手。
胡冲皱眉，“振山小子你怎么看的，徐海已经来了！”
罗振山脸色大变，“胡叔小心，他不是徐海，是严家家主严华！”
“什么！”
胡冲脸色一变。
罗家众人，亦面露惊怒。
难怪严家敢动手，严华竟已暗中突破，若徐海趁机发难……众人背心一阵发凉！
content_en:
The conflict between the Yan and Luo families broke out directly after the Jinding auction ended!
It is said that a caravan of the Yan family encountered horse thieves outside the city. They got conclusive evidence related to the Luo family and immediately came to the door.
It was a crude and lame excuse, but no one cared about it. All forces in Jiangning City were paying close attention to the progress of the situation.
I am not optimistic about the Luo family!
The Hu family's help has arrived, but the Yan family still dares to take action, which shows that they are very confident. There are many smart people, and the dispute over Luo Zhenyang's Tongtiangu ended not long ago... Many eyes were looking at the pier in the north of the city.
Recently, the Qingjiang Gang has indeed made some changes.
The Luo family mansion!
The Yan and Luo families were already fighting together, and the sound of killing was loud!
The lame servant in the ancestral hall now straightened his back and his eyes were filled with energy, "Yan Shuo, do you really think you can move the Luo family?"
The ancestor of the Yan family sneered, "After today, there will no longer be a Luo family in Jiangning!" He stepped down, the bluestone on the road shattered, and the people were like ferocious beasts, killing them fiercely.
The lame servant responded with a sneer, and the two old men, whose combined age was nearly 200 years old, burst out with a shocking and terrifying power. The fists and feet collided with loud explosions, causing the ground to shatter and rocks to fly, causing everyone to retreat.
It is not for them to interfere in the battlefield of Ten Thousand Level Realm.
Hu Chong was in his fifties, with a short body and extremely thick thighs, which showed that his lower body was extremely stable. He had a fierce look in his eyes and his voice sounded like a drum beating in his chest, "Zhenshan, let me take action!"
Luo Zhenshan shook his head, "Xu Hai hasn't shown up yet, please wait a moment, Uncle Hu."
He couldn't help but frown.
Now that the war has broken out and the Qingjiang Gang has joined forces with the Yan family, why doesn't Xu Hai show up? Is there another conspiracy in it?
On the other side, Yan Hua's face was also gloomy.
His cold eyes fell on the person next to him, "Where is your gang leader?"
The person being stared at was sweating profusely, "This... villain doesn't even know..."
According to the plan, Xu Hai entangled Hu Chong, so that he could destroy everything and defeat the masters of the Luo family's Thousand Mountain Realm.
By then, the overall situation will be decided!
Unexpectedly, Xu Hai didn't show up at the critical moment. Could this damn bastard just sit on the mountain and watch the fight between tigers and tigers?
Yan Hua's face became even more ugly.
Hu Chong said in a deep voice: "Zhenshan, we can't wait any longer. I'll start by severely injuring several masters of the Yan family. Even if the other party has a conspiracy, we can still have the advantage."
Luo Zhenshan gritted his teeth, "Okay, Uncle Hu, be careful!"
"Hahaha! Don't worry!" Hu Chong laughed and rushed out.
Bang——
After punching out, the Yan family's Thousand Mountain Realm master across from him looked horrified. He hurriedly resisted, but facing the powerful man, his body was like a big stone and was blown away.
He fell to the ground and rolled around several times, vomiting blood, and lost his fighting ability.
Hu Chong made a turn and rushed to the next master of the Yan family. He had already locked onto the target after observing the battle situation, and struck quickly and ruthlessly.
Yan Hua growled, "Xu Hai, Shu Ziye!"
Boom——
His aura surged, instantly breaking through the Ten Thousand Levels Realm and rushing towards Hu Chong. He couldn't stand by and watch Hu Chong join the pack of wolves like a tiger, severely injuring the Yan family's Thousand Mountain Realm masters.
Hu Chong frowned, "Zhenshan boy, what do you think? Xu Hai is already here!"
Luo Zhenshan's expression changed greatly, "Uncle Hu, be careful, he is not Xu Hai, he is Yan Hua, the head of the Yan family!"
"What!"
Hu Chong's expression changed.
Everyone in the Luo family also looked shocked and angry.
No wonder the Yan family dared to take action, but Yan Hua had secretly made a breakthrough. If Xu Hai took the opportunity to attack... everyone would feel chills in their chests!
